title: task_summary
prompt: Write task_summary(tasks) returning the string 'X done / Y total'. Zero tasks: '0 done / 0 total'.

tests.name: counts correctly
tests.code:
tasks = [{"text": "a", "done": True}, {"text": "b", "done": False}, {"text": "c", "done": True}]
assert task_summary(tasks) == "2 done / 3 total", f"got {task_summary(tasks)}"
assert task_summary([]) == "0 done / 0 total"
tests.hint: done = sum(1 for t in tasks if t["done"]); f"{done} done / {len(tasks)} total"
